summary:
Three-move token efficiency overhaul plan:

Move 1 (Tiered Kickoff): Replaces monolithic session-kickoff with Sport Mode (3 tool calls, default) and Race Mode (full ceremony, for deep work). end-session becomes a simple handoff summary by default.

Move 2 (Internalized Chain): Steps 1-3 of The Chain execute in-head without file reads for known domains. Saves ~2,200 tokens per routine request.

Move 3 (Hot Context Cache): Prevents redundant expert file reads within a conversation. Adds Tier Hot to the Context Engine.

Files modified: session-kickoff.md, end-session.md, session_workspace.py, GEMINI.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, token-efficiency-protocol.md, session-state-protocol.md.

Estimated combined savings: 30-50% token reduction on typical daily usage with zero capability loss.
